### Fig 3f
```{r fig3f, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.2, dpi=450}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


# ---- 1) De novo rename map: SBS96A->Sig1 ... SBS96D->Sig4 ----
denovo_map <- c(
  "Signature 96-A" = "Sig1",
  "Signature 96-B" = "Sig2",
  "Signature 96-C" = "Sig3",
  "Signature 96-D" = "Sig4",
  "SBS96A" = "Sig1",
  "SBS96B" = "Sig2",
  "SBS96C" = "Sig3",
  "SBS96D" = "Sig4"
)

# ---- 2) Parse "Global NMF Signatures" into long df: (denovo, cosmic, pct) ----
# cosmic_refit_mutSig_vcf columns:
# `De novo extracted`, `Global NMF Signatures`, ...
df_cosmic_refit_mutSig_vcf <- cosmic_refit_mutSig_vcf %>%
  transmute(
    denovo_raw = `De novo extracted`,
    mix_raw = `Global NMF Signatures`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    denovo = recode(denovo_raw, !!!denovo_map, .default = denovo_raw),
    # Split by '&'
    mix_raw = str_replace_all(mix_raw, "\\s*&\\s*", "&"),
    parts = str_split(mix_raw, "&", simplify = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_longer(parts) %>%
  mutate(
    parts = str_trim(parts),
    # Extract SBS id + percent in parentheses
    cosmic = str_extract(parts, "SBS\\d+"),
    pct = as.numeric(str_match(parts, "\\(([-0-9.]+)%\\)")[,2])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cosmic), !is.na(pct)) %>%
  select(denovo, cosmic, pct)

# ---- 3) Plot: bubble, fill by cosmic (pastel), label pct ----
y_levels <- c("Sig1","Sig2","Sig3","Sig4")

cosmic_cols <- c(
  SBS1  = "#A8DADC",  # pastel cyan
  SBS2  = "#F4A261",  # soft orange
  SBS5  = "#8EC9B8",  # mint
  SBS8  = "#C9CCD6",  # light grey-lavender
  SBS16 = "#B8A1D9",  # pastel purple
  SBS31 = "#F6BD60",  # soft yellow-orange
  SBS32 = "#9DB4E0"   # pastel blue
)
x_levels <- cosmic_cols %>% names(.)

ggplot(
  df_cosmic_refit_mutSig_vcf %>%
    mutate(
      cosmic = factor(cosmic, levels = x_levels),
      denovo = factor(denovo, levels = y_levels)
    )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = cosmic, y = denovo, size = pct, fill = cosmic),
    shape = 21,
    color = "grey20",
    stroke = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = cosmic, y = denovo, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    family = "Arial",
    size = 7 / ggplot2::.pt,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cosmic_cols, name = "COSMIC") +
  scale_size(
    range = c(9, 18),
    breaks = c(10, 25, 50, 75),
    name = "Contribution (%)"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(factor(y_levels)))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 7)
```

### Fig 3g
```{r fig3g, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.9, dpi=450}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

# ---- make matrix: rows = 96 contexts, cols = samples ----
mat_96 <- vcf_trinuc %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("MutationType") %>%
  as.matrix()

# ---- cosine similarity between samples (columns) ----
cos_sim_cols <- function(m){
  m_scaled <- apply(m, 2, function(x){
    s2 <- sum(x^2)
    if (s2 == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
    x / sqrt(s2)
  })
  t(m_scaled) %*% m_scaled
}

sim_96 <- cos_sim_cols(mat_96)

# ---- cosine distance + clustering ----
dist_96 <- 1 - sim_96
dist_96[dist_96 < 0] <- 0
diag(dist_96) <- 0

hc_96 <- hclust(as.dist(dist_96), method = "average")
sample_labels_96 <- normalize_seq_method(colnames(sim_96))


col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
  c("#FFFFFF",
    "#E3EEF9",
    "#9ECAE1",
    "#2171B5",
    "#08306B")
)
ht <- Heatmap(
  sim_96,
  name = "Cosine\nSimilarity",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = as.dendrogram(hc_96),
  cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(hc_96),
  row_labels = sample_labels_96,
  column_labels = sample_labels_96,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  column_dend_height = unit(30, "mm"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 45,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
    labels = c("0", "0.5", "0.75", "0.9", "1"),
    title = "Cosine similarity",
    title_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7)
  )
)

draw(ht)

```

### Fig 3h
```{r fig3h, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.0, dpi=450}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

trin <- mutSig_vcf %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Sig1 = SBS96A,
    Sig2 = SBS96B,
    Sig3 = SBS96C,
    Sig4 = SBS96D
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Sig1, Sig2, Sig3, Sig4),
    names_to = "trinuc",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Samples,
    values_from = value
  )

mat_raw <- trin %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("trinuc") %>%
  as.matrix()

# ---- relative activity (% within each sample) ----
mat_sig_pct <- apply(mat_raw, 2, function(x){
  s <- sum(x)
  if (s == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  100 * x / s
})
mat_sig_pct <- as.matrix(mat_sig_pct)
rownames(mat_sig_pct) <- rownames(mat_raw)   # Sig1-4
colnames(mat_sig_pct) <- colnames(mat_raw)   # Samples

# ---- red-ish palette ----
col_fun_red <- colorRamp2( c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), c("#FFF5F0", "#FCAE91", "#FB6A4A", "#DE2D26", "#A50F15") )
col_fun_red <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
  c("#FFFFFF",
    "#FDE0DD",
    "#FCAE91",
    "#FB6A4A",
    "#CB181D")
)
sample_labels_sig <- gsub(
  "_", " ",
  normalize_seq_method(colnames(mat_sig_pct)),
  fixed = TRUE
)

ht_sig <- Heatmap(
  mat_sig_pct,
  name = "Activity\n(%)",
  col = col_fun_red,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(hc_96),   # << keep the 96D dendrogram
  column_labels = sample_labels_sig,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  column_dend_height = unit(30, "mm"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 90,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    color_bar = "continuous",
    at = c(0, 50, 100),
    labels = c("0", "50", "100"),
    title = "Activity (%)",
    title_position = "topleft",
    legend_direction = "vertical",
    legend_height = unit(30, "mm"),
    legend_width = unit(3, "mm"),
    tick_length = unit(1, "mm"),
    border = NA,
    title_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 7)
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill){
    grid.text(
      sprintf("%.1f", mat_sig_pct[i, j]), x, y,
      gp = gpar(
        fontfamily = "Arial",
        fontsize = 7,
        col = ifelse(mat_sig_pct[i, j] >= 80, "white", "black")
      )
    )
  }
)

draw(ht_sig)

```
